# The closed subgroup generated by a Frobenius lift is totally disconnected

This module proves the theorem
`Langlands.NYLL.ClassFormation.DegreeData.frobeniusClosure_totallyDisconnectedSpace`, the proof phase of
M014.038 in the
[NYLL partition](../../../../../../../../notes/reuse/nyll-public-port/m001-m024.md#m014).
Its type is the published proposition
`Langlands.NYLL.ClassFormation.DegreeData.frobeniusClosure_totallyDisconnectedSpaceStatement` applied to the
theorem's parameters:

```lean
theorem frobeniusClosure_totallyDisconnectedSpace (D : DegreeData G)
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (K : FiniteResidueAbstractField D) (L : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.field.toSubgroup)
    [hLnormal : (L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup).Normal]
    (σ : D.FrobeniusElements K L hLK) :
    frobeniusClosure_totallyDisconnectedSpaceStatement D K L hLK σ
```

## Target and binders

The theorem has the binders of the published target, in the same order: the section variables `{G : Type u} [Group G] [TopologicalSpace G]` (the ambient group with its group structure and topology, in the source universe `u`), then the explicit parameter `D : DegreeData G` (M010.002, the degree datum: a continuous surjective degree homomorphism `G → ℤ̂`), the instance arguments `[IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]` (`G` is a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group, that is, a profinite group), `K : FiniteResidueAbstractField D` (M010.021, an abstract field with finite residue degree), `L : ClosedSubgroup G` and `hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.field.toSubgroup` (an abstract extension `L` of `K`), the instance argument `[hLnormal : (L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup).Normal]` (normality of `L` in `K`) and `σ : D.FrobeniusElements K L hLK` (a Frobenius lift, M012.009: a class `σ` in `G(\widetilde L|K) = K.field.toSubgroup ⧸ D.extensionInertiaWithin K.field L hLK` together with the property that its normalized degree `D.extensionNormalizedDegree K L hLK σ` (M012.005) is `(Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZHat)) ^ n` for some natural number `n > 0`). The source writes the subgroup in `hLnormal` as `extensionSubgroup K.field L hLK`, an abbreviation whose body is exactly `L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup`; the published target uses the body.

By its definition in the published module `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.AbstractClassFieldTheory.Degree.FrobeniusFixedField.FrobeniusClosure.Statements`, the target is the proposition

```lean
TotallyDisconnectedSpace (D.frobeniusClosure K L hLK σ)
```

That is, the closed subgroup `Γ = frobeniusClosure` (M014.023) of `G(\widetilde L|K)`, with its subspace topology, is totally disconnected. No hypothesis is added.

## Imports and dependencies

The module imports, unchanged:

- `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.AbstractClassFieldTheory.Degree.FrobeniusFixedField.FrobeniusClosure.Statements`, which defines the target and imports the published definitions `frobeniusClosure` (M014.023), `extensionInertiaWithin` (M012.002: the subgroup `L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup ⊓ D.fieldInertiaWithin K.field` of `K.field.toSubgroup`), `fieldInertiaWithin` (M010.014: the elements of degree `1`) and `restrictedDegree` (M010.008, the continuous degree map restricted to `K.field.toSubgroup`);
- `Langlands.NYLL.GaloisCohomology.Topology.TotallyDisconnectedQuotients.U001.Proofs`, which provides the published theorem `QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace_of_isClosed` (M013.001): the quotient of a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group by a closed normal subgroup is totally disconnected.

The module opens no namespace.

## Implemented proof

The proof unfolds the target with `show` and then follows the source. `K.field.toSubgroup` is compact, because `K.field` is a closed subgroup of the compact group `G` (local instance from `infer_instance` after `change CompactSpace K.field`). The local hypothesis `hN` states that the extension inertia `D.extensionInertiaWithin K.field L hLK` (M012.002) is closed in `K.field.toSubgroup`; it is proved by the source proof of M014.022 `extensionInertiaWithin_isClosed`: the subgroup `L.toSubgroup.subgroupOf K.field.toSubgroup` is the preimage of the closed set `L` under the continuous inclusion (`hE`), the subgroup `D.fieldInertiaWithin K.field` is the set where the continuous restricted degree equals `1` in the Hausdorff group `ZHatMul` (`hI`, by `isClosed_eq`), and the extension inertia is their intersection. The published M013.001 applied to this closed normal subgroup and `hN` makes the quotient `Q = K.field.toSubgroup ⧸ D.extensionInertiaWithin K.field L hLK` totally disconnected, and `infer_instance` gives total disconnectedness of the subspace `Γ ⊆ Q` (Mathlib's instance for subtypes of totally disconnected spaces).

## Original passage and modifications

The source is Naganori Yamaguchi's
[`n-yamaguchi-0729/ClassFieldTheory`](https://github.com/n-yamaguchi-0729/ClassFieldTheory/tree/fbd320cd8b1b06487c58227e92eb135794267709), commit `fbd320cd8b1b06487c58227e92eb135794267709`. The exact
passage is
[`Nyll/ClassFieldTheory/AbstractClassFieldTheory/Degree/FrobeniusFixedField.lean`, lines 841–858](https://github.com/n-yamaguchi-0729/ClassFieldTheory/blob/fbd320cd8b1b06487c58227e92eb135794267709/Nyll/ClassFieldTheory/AbstractClassFieldTheory/Degree/FrobeniusFixedField.lean#L841-L858):
the docstring at line 841 and the theorem at lines 842–858. It lies in `namespace ClassFormation` (line 19), with `open CyclicCohomology` (line 21), its `noncomputable section` (line 25), `universe u` (line 27), the group variables of line 29 and `namespace DegreeData` (line 300). The source is:

```lean
/-- The closed cyclic group `Γ` is totally disconnected. -/
theorem frobeniusClosure_totallyDisconnectedSpace (D : DegreeData G)
    [IsTopologicalGroup G] [CompactSpace G] [T2Space G]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace G]
    (K : FiniteResidueAbstractField D) (L : ClosedSubgroup G)
    (hLK : L.toSubgroup ≤ K.field.toSubgroup)
    [hLnormal : (extensionSubgroup K.field L hLK).Normal]
    (σ : D.FrobeniusElements K L hLK) :
    TotallyDisconnectedSpace (D.frobeniusClosure K L hLK σ) := by
  let : CompactSpace K.field.toSubgroup := by
    change CompactSpace K.field
    infer_instance
  let Q := K.field.toSubgroup ⧸ D.extensionInertiaWithin K.field L hLK
  let : TotallyDisconnectedSpace Q :=
    QuotientGroup.totallyDisconnectedSpace_of_isClosed
      (D.extensionInertiaWithin K.field L hLK)
      (D.extensionInertiaWithin_isClosed K L hLK)
  infer_instance
```
